purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for parse/resolve/authorize/dispatch/result/error traces across command executions without exposing sensitive arguments or granting execution authority.

topics.name: Command Execution Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for parse/resolve/authorize/dispatch/result/error traces across command executions without exposing sensitive arguments or granting execution authority.

semantics.redaction_rule: Secrets/restricted arguments/results are redacted according to policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing execution trace does not grant re-run/cancel/write authority.
semantics.action_rule: Re-run/cancel controls, if exposed, invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.trace_rule: Each execution retains stable runtime execution identity and provenance to command definition.

invariants.rule: Executable commands resolve by exact canonical identity and schema, cross one governed dispatcher boundary, and never infer authority from capability presence or parser success.

hard_gates.condition: command identified only by display label
execution trace loses command definition ref
